decisions.statement: A foundation is the namespaces, the roles and the operator configuration a cluster needs first.
A foundation names no image, no replicas and no container port.
A foundation emits no resource carrying a pod template.
A workload a foundation configures is a vendored workload rather than part of the foundation.
A foundation is put up before any service the foundation's namespaces hold.
Every manifest no service names is a manifest a foundation names.

definition: what a cluster is built on, written here and running as no workload of its own
